observations: Three photos show a used car engine and gearbox assembly on a concrete floor, likely in a workshop or yard.
The engine is dirty, with visible grime, oil stains, and some rust on metal parts.
Photo 0 and 1 are nearly identical, showing the front and top of the engine with intake manifold, throttle body, and various hoses and wires.
Photo 2 shows the rear of the engine, with the transmission attached, and a white sticker on the black oil pan.
The sticker on the oil pan in photo 2 is too blurry to read any text or numbers.
No visible branding or model markings are legible on the engine block, cylinder head, or transmission casing.
The engine appears to be a 4-cylinder inline unit, common in compact cars, with a carburetor or early fuel injection setup.
The surrounding area is cluttered with other engine parts, suggesting a salvage or repair environment.

claims.evidence: No visible Mitsubishi branding or model number on the engine in any photo. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.claim: all engine and gearbox is sold with 3 months guarantee
claims.evidence: The guarantee is a seller promise not visible in the photos. No documentation or proof is shown.

risks.proof: A video showing the engine running or a close-up of the oil pan and cylinder head for signs of sludge, cracks, or leaks.

risks.risk: Transmission may be faulty or mismatched to the engine
risks.proof: A close-up of the transmission model number or a video showing gear engagement and fluid condition.

risks.risk: Engine is not Mitsubishi as claimed
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing the brand name or model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown brand, which may be lower value

risks.risk: Engine has been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine's serial number matching a known wrecked vehicle record.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, which may reduce value

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing the brand and model number.
Close-up of the transmission casing with model number.
Video of the engine running or a test of the transmission gears.
Photo of the VIN plate or engine serial number for provenance check.
response.reason: The engine's brand and model cannot be identified from the photos, and the seller's claim of it being a Mitsubishi is unverified. Without proof of identity and condition, a worst-case price cannot be determined. The guarantee is also unverifiable remotely. Proof of brand, model, and working condition is needed before pricing.
